message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of an iterative agent-improvement process, showing benchmarked agents and expanding groups of agents used to produce later versions.","description":"Three rounded panels show Agent 0, Agent 1, and Agent 2 from left to right. Each panel contains a code block (respectively “Base Code,” “Agent 1 Code,” and “Agent 2 Code”), a “Benchmarks” block, and three benchmark blocks labeled “Bench 1,” “Bench 2,” and “Bench 3.” Thin gray guide lines group the benchmark blocks beneath the Benchmarks heading. Blue arrows point right into Agent 1, Agent 2, and an ellipsis for later agents; each incoming arrow is labeled vertically “Meta-Improvement.” Beneath the panels, black bracket-like lines identify increasingly broad agent groups: “Base Agent” under Agent 0, “Best Agent 0, 1” under Agents 0 and 1, and “Best Agent 0, ..., 2” under Agents 0 through 2. Blue connector lines rise from these groups and lead to the next agent’s incoming arrow, indicating that each later agent is produced through meta-improvement using the best agent or agents accumulated so far. The ellipsis indicates the process continues beyond Agent 2.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
